Vector fields

Source: R/vector_field.R
VectorFieldClass.Rd

VectorField() holds a function mapping a position to a vector and provides methods to move other mobjects along the field. ArrowVectorField() draws the field as a grid of arrows and StreamLines() as traces of agents moving through it. Unless color is given, colors come from color_scheme (by default the vector's length) mapped onto the gradient colors.

Methods: nudge(mob, dt, substeps, pointwise), nudge_submobjects(dt, substeps, pointwise), get_nudge_updater(speed, pointwise), start_submobject_movement(speed, pointwise), stop_submobject_movement(), fit_to_coordinate_system(cs), shift_func(func, shift_vector), scale_func(func, scalar), get_colored_background_image(sampling_rate) (an RGB array) and get_vectorized_rgba_gradient_function(start, end, colors). StreamLines adds create(), start_animation() and end_animation().

Usage

DEFAULT_SCALAR_FIELD_COLORS

VectorField(
  func,
  color = NULL,
  color_scheme = NULL,
  min_color_scheme_value = 0,
  max_color_scheme_value = 2,
  colors = DEFAULT_SCALAR_FIELD_COLORS,
  ...
)

vector_field_shift_func(func, shift_vector)

vector_field_scale_func(func, scalar)

ArrowVectorField(
  func,
  color = NULL,
  color_scheme = NULL,
  min_color_scheme_value = 0,
  max_color_scheme_value = 2,
  colors = DEFAULT_SCALAR_FIELD_COLORS,
  x_range = NULL,
  y_range = NULL,
  z_range = NULL,
  three_dimensions = FALSE,
  length_func = NULL,
  opacity = 1,
  vector_config = NULL,
  ...
)

StreamLines(
  func,
  color = NULL,
  color_scheme = NULL,
  min_color_scheme_value = 0,
  max_color_scheme_value = 2,
  colors = DEFAULT_SCALAR_FIELD_COLORS,
  x_range = NULL,
  y_range = NULL,
  z_range = NULL,
  three_dimensions = FALSE,
  noise_factor = NULL,
  n_repeats = 1,
  dt = 0.05,
  virtual_time = 3,
  max_anchors_per_line = 100,
  padding = 3,
  stroke_width = 1,
  opacity = 1,
  ...
)

Arguments

func

Function of a position c(x, y, z) returning a vector.

color

Single color for the whole field; disables position based coloring.

color_scheme

Function mapping a vector to a number; defaults to its length.

min_color_scheme_value, max_color_scheme_value

Values mapped to the first and last of colors.

colors

Colors of the gradient.

...

Passed to VGroup().

shift_vector

Shift applied to the field.

scalar

Scale applied to the positions.

x_range, y_range, z_range

c(min, max, step) (step defaults to 0.5).

three_dimensions

Build a 3D grid (automatic when z_range is given).

length_func

Maps a vector's length to its displayed length.

opacity

Opacity of the arrows or stream lines.

vector_config

Named list passed to Vector().

noise_factor

Random offset of the stream line starting points; defaults to half of the y step.

n_repeats

Number of agents per starting point.

dt

Integration step of the stream lines.

virtual_time

Simulated time; longer gives longer stream lines.

max_anchors_per_line

Maximum anchors per stream line.

padding

Distance agents may leave the spawning area.

stroke_width

Stroke width of the stream lines.

Value

The constructors return mobjects: R6 objects of the class named by the function called. vector_field_shift_func() and vector_field_scale_func() return functions, and DEFAULT_SCALAR_FIELD_COLORS is a character vector of colors. The objects whose names end in Class are the R6 class generators that these functions call.

Details

As upstream, stream lines in the plane are colored through a background image of the field's colors (get_colored_background_image(), so a line's color changes along it with the field), and 3D stream lines get a stroke gradient from the colors at their anchors.

Examples

func <- function(pos) ((pos[1] * UR + pos[2] * LEFT) - pos) / 3
ArrowVectorField(func, x_range = c(-3, 3, 1), y_range = c(-2, 2, 1))
#> <ArrowVectorField> 0 points, 35 submobjects
# \donttest{
# Tracing stream lines takes a few seconds.
StreamLines(func, x_range = c(-3, 3, 1), y_range = c(-2, 2, 1))
#> <StreamLines> 0 points, 35 submobjects
# }
